# Deleting !LoadedObject Customer deletes all CartRules that don't have customer restrictions

This does not happen in regular use but happens when someone (me) does integration without checking everything all the time (which is way too easy)

Take this code:

```php
$Customer = new Customer(-1);
$Customer->delete();
```

delete does not complain anything BUT there is a side effect!

Customer::delete https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/65e20f37cfe40d4ad47480ada09c4fc45a4fa0f0/classes/Customer.php#L416

Does `CartRule::deleteByIdCustomer((int) $this->id);` but because the Customer was not really loaded (id -1 does not exists) the Customer object id is `null` but casting null to int makes it zero...

https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/65e20f37cfe40d4ad47480ada09c4fc45a4fa0f0/classes/CartRule.php#L614

`deleteByIdCustomer` does not check for 0 being a case and selects all CartRules where id_customer==0 and happily deletes them.

## Attendu
* Calling $Object->delete() when object is not valid loaded object should fail.
* `deleteByIdCustomer` should never be able to delete CartRules that do not have Customer condition set (e.g id_customer is 0)

## Étapes
1. Create CartRules with and withourt customer conditions
2. run the code above

=> all CartRules that didn't have customer conditions set are deleted
